hint: The image is a side-by-side panel showing the same moment from {n} fixed camera{s}. A robot hand, palm up, holds a cube whose faces are coloured. The hand may hide parts of the cube.

up: Which colour covers most of the cube face that points up (toward the sky)?
turned: Apart from the white face and the magenta face, does each face of the cube show a single colour, or does each show a wide part of one colour and a narrow strip of another colour?
Each face shows a single colour
Each face shows a wide part and a narrow strip of another colour
band: Find the cube face that is mostly red. What colour is the narrow strip along one of its edges?
There is no strip; the face is red only
